CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Autumn-2020 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Autumn-2020 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 2,867 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 8 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: April 2020 to June 2020). These surveys captured 205 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 4 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 379 cards across 32 sites, with 11.9% showing evidence of mouse activity (45 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 148 transects across 32 sites (survey period: May 2020 to May 2020), detecting active burrows in 7.4% of transects (total: 52 active burrows).
